worker_output.summary: Implemented the full save/load persistence system. (1) src/game/persistence.ts: Pure functions — serializeState() wraps GameState in a versioned SaveEnvelope (version + savedAt timestamp + state) and JSON-serializes it; deserializeState() parses + validates the envelope and returns GameState | null (null on bad JSON, missing fields, or wrong version); saveGame() / loadGame() read-write to localStorage key 'hamster-of-orion-save', silently swallowing any storage errors; deleteSave() removes the key; hasSave() checks for key existence. All error paths return null or no-op — never throw. SaveEnvelope interface and isSaveEnvelope type guard ensure no `any` types. (2) src/ui/persistence.ts: DOM helpers — exportSaveFile() creates a Blob, attaches a hidden <a> with download attr, clicks it, then revokes the object URL after 1 s; importSaveFile() returns Promise<GameState | null> — opens a file picker via <input type=file>, reads the selected .json with FileReader, passes text to deserializeState(), resolves null on cancel or error (cancel detected via window focus + 300 ms grace period). (3) test/game/persistence.test.ts: 20 unit tests covering serializeState (produces valid JSON, correct envelope shape, savedAt timestamp range), deserializeState (round-trip, empty string, invalid JSON, missing fields, wrong version, raw state object), and the localStorage integration suite for saveGame / loadGame / deleteSave / hasSave using vi.stubGlobal to mock localStorage. All 449 tests pass (0 typecheck errors).
